"""Live controller for the VLABench select_mahjong_semantic episode.

This script intentionally uses only rcb_client observations and public robot
commands. Run from the task environment with /opt/tools on PYTHONPATH.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


def joint_target(robot, joints, fingers=0.04, duration=1.0, dt=0.1, note=""):
    """Move linearly to seven arm joint targets with symmetric finger opening."""
    current = np.asarray(robot.status().get("proprio", {}).get("now", []), dtype=float)
    # State values are normally returned in res.meta; callers pass all 9 targets.
    target = np.r_[np.asarray(joints, dtype=float), fingers, fingers]
    count = max(1, int(round(duration / dt)))
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(target[None, :], count, axis=0),
                        dt=dt, interpolate="linear", cameras=["forward"],
                        video="none", note=note)


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print("spec", robot.spec())
    print("status", robot.status())
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"],
                        include_depth=True, video="none")
    print("observation", obs.meta)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Live controller for VLABench select_mahjong_semantic.

The controller uses only rcb_client camera, depth, and proprioception data.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
DT = 0.1


def state(robot):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward'], video='none')
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    return now[:7].copy(), now[16:19].copy(), now[19:23].copy(), obs.meta


def send_q(robot, q, fingers=0.04, seconds=0.5, note=''):
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    target = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), fingers, fingers]
    res = robot.submit('joint_position', np.repeat(target[None, :], n, axis=0),
                       dt=DT, interpolate='linear', cameras=['forward'],
                       video='none', note=note)
    return res


def quat_multiply(a, b):
    aw, ax, ay, az = a
    bw, bx, by, bz = b
    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])


def orientation_error(q_goal, q_now):
    """World-frame axis-angle taking q_now to q_goal."""
    inv = q_now.copy(); inv[1:] *= -1
    dq = quat_multiply(q_goal, inv)
    if dq[0] < 0: dq *= -1
    vn = np.linalg.norm(dq[1:])
    if vn < 1e-10: return np.zeros(3)
    return dq[1:] / vn * (2*np.arctan2(vn, dq[0]))


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print(json.dumps({'spec': robot.spec(), 'status': robot.status()}, indent=2))
    q, p, quat, meta = state(robot)
    print('q', q.tolist(), 'tcp', p.tolist(), 'quat', quat.tolist())
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],
                        include_depth=True, video='none')
    for name, img in obs.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(img).save(str(OUT / f'{name}_latest.png'))
    for name, dep in obs.depth.items():
        np.save(OUT / f'{name}_latest_depth.npy', dep)
    print('observation', obs.meta)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Live controller for VLABench select_mahjong_semantic.

The controller uses only rcb_client camera, depth, and proprioception data.

import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
DT = 0.1


def state(robot):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward'], video='none')
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    return now[:7].copy(), now[16:19].copy(), now[19:23].copy(), obs.meta


def send_q(robot, q, fingers=None, seconds=0.5, note=''):
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    if fingers is None:
        _, _, _, meta = state(robot)
        finger_pair = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'][30:32], dtype=float)
    elif np.ndim(fingers) == 0:
        finger_pair = np.repeat(float(fingers), 2)
    else:
        finger_pair = np.asarray(fingers, dtype=float).reshape(2)
    target = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), finger_pair]
    res = robot.submit('joint_position', np.repeat(target[None, :], n, axis=0),
                       dt=DT, interpolate='linear', cameras=['forward'],
                       video='none', note=note)
    return res


def rotate_gripper_axis(robot, angle_rad, seconds=1.5, note='rotate open gripper'):
    """Rotate joint 7 while holding the TCP position and leaving fingers open."""
    _, _, _, meta = state(robot)
    qcmd = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'][23:30], dtype=float)
    qnext = qcmd.copy(); qnext[6] += float(angle_rad)
    lim = np.asarray(robot.spec()['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])[6]
    if qnext[6] <= lim[0] + 0.01 or qnext[6] >= lim[1] - 0.01:
        raise RuntimeError('wrist rotation would approach Panda joint 7 limit')
    res = send_q(robot, qnext, seconds=seconds, note=note)
    q, p, quat, _ = state(robot)
    record = {'angle_rad': float(angle_rad), 'q_command': qnext.tolist(),
              'q_after': q.tolist(), 'p_after': p.tolist(),
              'quat_after': quat.tolist(), 'meta': res.meta}
    (OUT / 'wrist_rotation.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    return q, p, quat


def set_fingers(robot, opening, seconds=1.0, note='set gripper opening'):
    """Command both Panda fingers to the same 0..0.04 m position."""
    if not (0.0 <= opening <= 0.04):
        raise ValueError('finger target must be in [0, 0.04] m')
    _, _, _, meta = state(robot)
    qcmd = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'][23:30], dtype=float)
    res = send_q(robot, qcmd, fingers=opening, seconds=seconds, note=note)
    q, p, quat, meta = state(robot)
    now = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    record = {'opening_command': float(opening), 'finger_positions': now[14:16].tolist(),
              'tcp': p.tolist(), 'quat': quat.tolist(), 'q': q.tolist(), 'meta': res.meta}
    (OUT / 'finger_action.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    return record


def quat_multiply(a, b):
    aw, ax, ay, az = a
    bw, bx, by, bz = b
    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])


def orientation_error(q_goal, q_now):
    """World-frame axis-angle taking q_now to q_goal."""
    inv = q_now.copy(); inv[1:] *= -1
    dq = quat_multiply(q_goal, inv)
    if dq[0] < 0: dq *= -1
    vn = np.linalg.norm(dq[1:])
    if vn < 1e-10: return np.zeros(3)
    return dq[1:] / vn * (2*np.arctan2(vn, dq[0]))


def calibrate_jacobian(robot, delta=0.04, settle_s=1.0):
    """Estimate TCP Jacobians around the last commanded pose with reversible probes."""
    _, _, _, meta = state(robot)
    base_cmd = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'][23:30], dtype=float)
    jp = np.zeros((3, 7)); jr = np.zeros((3, 7)); samples = []
    send_q(robot, base_cmd, seconds=settle_s, note='settle at Jacobian base command')

        probe = send_q(robot, q1, seconds=settle_s, note=f'jacobian probe joint {j+1}')

    dr = np.zeros(3) if dr is None else np.asarray(dr, dtype=float)

    b = np.r_[np.asarray(dp, dtype=float), rot_weight * dr]

        res = send_q(robot, qnext, seconds=1.5, note=f'{note} Cartesian step {iteration+1}')

        item = {'iteration': iteration+1, 'before_q': q.tolist(), 'before_p': p.tolist(),
                'before_quat': quat.tolist(), 'position_error': pos_error,
                'rotation_error': rot_error, 'dp': dp.tolist(), 'dr': dr.tolist(),
                'dq': dq.tolist(), 'scale': scale, 'q_command': qnext.tolist(),
                'after_q': q2.tolist(), 'after_p': p2.tolist(),
                'after_quat': quat2.tolist(), 'probe_samples': probes,
                'meta': res.meta}
        history.append(item)
        (OUT / f'{note.replace(" ", "_")}_history.json').write_text(
            json.dumps({'target_pos': target_pos.tolist(), 'target_quat': target_quat.tolist(),

                        'dq': dq.tolist(), 'scale': scale,
                        'q_command': qnext.tolist(), 'after_q': q2.tolist(),
                        'after_p': p2.tolist(), 'after_quat': quat2.tolist(),
                        'meta': res.meta})
        (OUT / f'{note.replace(" ", "_")}_history.json').write_text(
            json.dumps({'target_pos': target_pos.tolist(),
                        'target_quat': target_quat.tolist(),
                        'history': history, 'J_position': jp.tolist(),
                        'J_rotation': jr.tolist()}, indent=2))
        if np.linalg.norm(dp_actual) < 0.002 and distance > 0.04:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{note}: hand did not progress toward target')
    q, p, quat, _ = state(robot)
    return q, p, quat, history, jp, jr


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print(json.dumps({'spec': robot.spec(), 'status': robot.status()}, indent=2))
    q, p, quat, meta = state(robot)
    print('q', q.tolist(), 'tcp', p.tolist(), 'quat', quat.tolist())
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],
                        include_depth=True, video='none')
    for name, img in obs.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(img).save(str(OUT / f'{name}_latest.png'))
    for name, dep in obs.depth.items():
        np.save(OUT / f'{name}_latest_depth.npy', dep)
    print('observation', obs.meta)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
